name: Crosslink
one_liner: Crosslink measures whether a private payment is actually private. StarkWare's bridgeOutToWallet already does unlinkable payout to any address — what nothing does is tell you whether the anonymity set is deep enough for that to mean anything. Our Linkability Meter scores a pending send against the live mainnet pool on amount uniqueness, timing, channel freshness and plausible-set size, and blocks the send when privacy would be fake. Live on mainnet; it gated our own transfers. Roadmap: an embeddable toggle protocols can drop into their own send flow, and USDC cross-chain corridors via CCTP.
summary: Measures privacy validity of STRK20 payouts with a live Linkability Meter.
description_long: Crosslink assesses whether a private STRK20 payout is unlinkable based on the pool's current anonymity set. It features a Linkability Meter that scores pending sends on criteria such as uniqueness, timing correlation, and pool depth, and it blocks any sends deemed non-privacy-conforming.
